THE CHINA PRESS, FRIDAY, JANUARY 5, 1934

Owen Lattimore Is New
'Pacific Affairs' Editor

The Institute of Pacific Relations
has appointed Mr. Owen Lattimore,
well known Far Eastern authority,
editor of "Pacific Affairs," official
organ of the Institute. The publi-
cation, formerly a monthly, will be
enlarged and will henceforth be
published as a quarterly.

《字林西报》，1934年1月5日，星期五

欧文·拉铁摩尔任新版
《太平洋事务》编辑

太平洋国际学会已任命著名远东问题专家欧文·拉铁摩尔先生为该学会官方刊物《太平洋事务》的编辑。该出版物原为月刊，现将扩充篇幅，并自此改为季刊出版。
